_comment: iCal feeds the updater pulls every run. All free, no API keys. For Luma calendars: open the calendar page -> 'Subscribe' -> copy the iCal URL (looks like https://api.lu.ma/ics/get?entity=calendar&id=cal-XXXX) and paste it here, then set enabled=true. Meetup groups: https://www.meetup.com/<group>/events/ical/ works out of the box. defaultType is used when the title doesn't reveal the type; eco marks vendor/ecosystem calendars.

sources.name: AI Agents Berlin (Luma)
sources.note: Open https://luma.com/aiagentsberlin -> Subscribe -> copy iCal URL, paste above, set enabled=true

sources.note: Open https://luma.com/tech-europe -> Subscribe -> copy iCal URL. Calendar covers several EU cities; the updater keeps only events whose location mentions Berlin.
